Include exactly 13 numbers in the response. In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with ease.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar streets of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of future forensics to leave clues that will aid her modern colleagues in catching the killer. But with each passing day, The Timekeeper seems to be one step ahead, always staying just out of reach.

Rachel's mission is to track down The Timekeeper and bring him to justice, but as she delves deeper into the case, she realizes that the killer's true identity is far more sinister than she ever could have imagined. With the help of a local detective, Jack Harris, Rachel must use all her skills and knowledge to unravel the mystery and prevent The Timekeeper from striking again.

As the body count rises, Rachel and Jack find themselves in a desperate race against time to catch the killer before he strikes again. But with The Timekeeper's ability to manipulate time, the stakes are higher than ever before. Can Rachel and Jack solve the case before The Timekeeper disappears into the timestream, or will they be left with nothing but a trail of cryptic clues and a killer who always seems to be one step ahead?

13 days, 5 cities, 3 continents, and countless lives hang in the balance as Rachel and Jack embark on a thrilling adventure through time. Will they be able to catch The Timekeeper before he kills again, or will he continue to haunt the ages, leaving a trail of death and destruction in his wake?"
